title: Introducing Olethog, the Primordial Golem. Now craftable in Mercenaries of Tezigdal as a Mythical-tier golem.
author: ADIRTYHOBO59
selftext:
[https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/](https://www.mercenariesoftezigdal.com/)

Mercenaries of Tezigdal is an in-browser MOBA inspired by League of Legends that features some key twists. With Implements you can purchase upgrades to your base to fortify structures or increase your utility. Faculties allow you to toggle off and on base functionality to increase passive gold. Golem Craft allows you to gather crafting materials in the jungle to create more powerful waves to flood the enemy base.  
  
When I started this project, I was using anything from Antigravity to Cursor but have settled on Codex with 6 Astra recently. The models are incredible for helping a developer move FAST. Though it does still take much mental effort to determine the intention that you are trying to bring into reality. That is something that models will never be capable of. Leveraging AI to fit as much of your intention as possible into your creation should be your goal!

Olethog specifically was modeled using GPT 6 Pro, relying on a couple of passes. The spawn animation also relied on GPT 6 Pro. The sounds relied on Eleven Labs. The sequence in game looks incredible.
